description: WP-G4 FORTIFICATION fall-back clause: when an enemy unit engaged with only FORTIFICATION units and not battle-shocked is selected to fall back, its hazard rolls are automatically passed. Fixture ork11e_g4_fort_move (P2 Custodes' Movement phase; Custodian Guard engaged with only the Big'ed Bossbunka). Setup privilege: the Guard is forced into desperate escape (CUT 'EM DOWN mark) — the movement panel only picks that mode when it is forced (battle-shocked units are excluded by the rule). Real clicks: the Guard token, then the Fall Back radio. The desperate-escape hazard rolls are reported as automatically passed (source Fortification), no model is hurt, and the Game Log says why.

steps.comment: setup privilege: a forced desperate escape (the CUT 'EM DOWN mark) — the movement panel only uses that mode when it is forced, and a battle-shocked unit is excluded by the rule
REAL click on the Fall Back radio

steps.script:
var hz = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance().active_moves.get("U_GUARD_A", {}).get("desperate_escape_ctx", {}).get("hazard", {})
return int(hz.get("failures", -1)) == 0 and str(hz.get("auto_passed_source", "")) == "Fortification" and int(hz.get("auto_passed", 0)) == 3
return int(GameState.state.units["U_GUARD_A"].models.filter(func(m): return m.get("alive", true) and int(m.get("current_wounds", 0)) == int(m.get("wounds", 0))).size())
